'''Voraxx''' were massive, [[Hair/Legends|hairy]] [[Species/Legends|creatures]] found in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] [[Derelkoos Desert]]. Tribes of the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] that lived in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] used voraxx as both mounts and [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] animals. Without the massive creatures, the Derelkoos Desert would have been nearly uninhabitable. Voraxx also lived on Klatooine's [[Ferelakk Savannah]] where, like in the Derelkoos Desert, they were used for riding and food. Voraxx were similar to [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]],<ref name="LoNH" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] species from the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Voraxx were introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="LoNH" />
